provenance: Hand-authored stand-in for the credential-free demo and CI. NOT recorded from IBM Bob and NOT evidence about Bob's diagnostic quality.

diagnosis.root_cause: database.pool_size in config/app.yaml was lowered to 2 (a load-shedding change). ConnectionPool in dbpool.py sizes itself from that value, so the third concurrent acquire raises ExhaustionError; test_pool_sized_from_config asserts production needs at least 10 concurrent connections.
assumptions: The regression is the config change in config/app.yaml, not a code change in dbpool.py
Production concurrency of at least 10 connections is the intended requirement
unresolved_uncertainty: Whether the load-shedding motivation for lowering pool_size still applies
